title: Extending Neural Operators: Robust Handling of Functions Beyond the Training Set
summary: We develop a rigorous framework for extending neural operators to handle out-of-distribution input functions. We leverage kernel approximation techniques and provide theory for characterizing the input-output function spaces in terms of Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Spaces (RKHSs). We provide theorems on the requirements for reliable extensions and their predicted approximation accuracy. We also establish formal relationships between specific kernel choices and their corresponding Sobolev Native Spaces.
